seoTitle: The Originals Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Originals test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Klaus, Elijah, Rebekah, Hayley, Marcel, Freya, Kol or Davina. Get your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one who wants to rule the whole city, the one holding the family together, or the one who just wants a normal life? Answer 12 everyday questions about loyalty, family and power, and find out which Originals character you are.

characters.name: Klaus Mikaelson
characters.title: The King Who Wants It All
characters.summary: Charming, dangerous and fiercely loving. You want power, loyalty and respect, and you don't forgive easily.
description: Like Klaus, you have big plans and a bigger temper. The Original hybrid came back to New Orleans, the city he helped build, determined to take it back as his own.
You have a softer side almost nobody gets to see. Klaus is a gifted painter, and his daughter Hope turned the most feared creature alive into a devoted dad.
Your problem is trust. Klaus is so afraid of being abandoned that he pushes people away first, then punishes them for leaving.
characters.flaw: You hold grudges for centuries, sometimes literally.
characters.signature: A paintbrush in one hand, a glass of bourbon in the other, and a smile that means trouble.
characters.clashReason: they'd take over everything and never let you forget who's in charge

characters.name: Elijah Mikaelson
characters.title: The Noble One
characters.summary: Calm, polished and loyal to the end. You're the one keeping the family together, whatever it costs you.
description: Like Elijah, you believe in honour, manners and keeping your word. He's never seen without a perfectly pressed suit, and he's always the calmest person in the room.
You'd do anything for the people you love. Elijah spent a thousand years trying to save his brother Klaus from himself, and cleaning up after him.
But there's a darkness under the manners. When someone threatens his family, Elijah can be more frightening than any of them.
characters.flaw: You put everyone else first until there's nothing left for you.
characters.signature: A perfect suit, a quiet warning and a handkerchief to wipe his hands afterwards.
characters.clashReason: they're so calm and proper it makes you want to scream

characters.name: Rebekah Mikaelson
characters.title: The Hopeless Romantic
characters.summary: Fierce, glamorous and loyal, but what you really want is to be loved and to live a normal life.
description: Like Rebekah, you can hold your own with anyone. She's the only Original sister, and she's never let her brothers push her around for long.
Deep down, you want something simple: real love and an ordinary life. Rebekah spent centuries dreaming of being human again, with a family of her own.
Your heart gets you into trouble. Rebekah fell for Marcel, which put her on the wrong side of Klaus, and her relationships rarely went smoothly.
characters.flaw: You fall for the wrong people, and you hate being left behind.
characters.signature: A perfect outfit, a fast car and a brother to argue with.
characters.clashReason: they'd be dramatic about everything, especially their love life

characters.name: Hayley Marshall
characters.title: The Fighter
characters.summary: Tough, protective and never afraid of a fight. You'd walk through fire for the people who need you.
description: Like Hayley, you're a survivor. She was a werewolf who grew up without her real family, and she came to New Orleans looking for them.
You're fierce about the people who depend on you. Hayley became the leader of the Crescent wolf pack and the mother of Hope, and she'd take on anyone to protect them.
You don't wait to be rescued. When it came down to it, Hayley gave up her own life to keep her daughter safe.
characters.flaw: You'd rather fight than admit you're scared.
characters.signature: A leather jacket, muddy boots and a look that says don't touch my family.
characters.clashReason: they'd pick a fight with you before hearing your side

characters.name: Marcel Gerard
characters.title: The Self-Made King
characters.summary: Charismatic, loyal and ambitious. You started with nothing, built your own kingdom, and you're the life of every party.
description: Like Marcel, you built your life yourself. Klaus took him in as a boy in 1800s New Orleans, and he grew up to rule the French Quarter on his own terms.
You're loyal to the people you take under your wing. Marcel protected the young witch Davina like family, and he has no patience for backstabbers.
You also know how to have a good time. The music, the crowds, the jazz clubs: Marcel loves his city, and it loves him back.
characters.flaw: You want to prove yourself to the people who raised you, and it clouds your judgement.
characters.signature: A jazz club, a rooftop party and the whole French Quarter calling him king.
characters.clashReason: they'd always want to be the one in charge

characters.name: Freya Mikaelson
characters.title: The Wise Protector
characters.summary: Wise, patient and quietly powerful. You'd give anything to keep your family together and safe.
description: Like Freya, you're the steady one. She's the eldest Mikaelson and a powerful witch, the one the family calls when they need a spell to save them.
You know what it's like to be on the outside. As a child Freya was taken from her family by her aunt Dahlia, and she spent centuries apart from her brothers and sister.
Now you want to make up for lost time. Freya fights for the family she finally found, and she found love of her own with the werewolf Keelin.
characters.flaw: You carry the family's problems as if they're all yours to fix.
characters.signature: Candles, an old spell book and a very stern look at her brothers.
characters.clashReason: they'd try to fix you when you didn't ask to be fixed

characters.name: Kol Mikaelson
characters.title: The Wild Card
characters.summary: Funny, reckless and hungry for attention. You hate being left out, and you make sure nobody forgets you're there.
description: Like Kol, you're the fun one, and the unpredictable one. The reckless Mikaelson brother loves chaos, and he's always up to something.
You hate being left out. Kol spent a long time feeling like the forgotten sibling, and a lot of his trouble-making was really a way of getting noticed.
You're more than people think. Kol was a witch before he became a vampire, and when he fell for Davina he showed how much he really had to give.
strengths: Loves hard when he finally lets himself
characters.flaw: You'd rather cause trouble than be ignored.
characters.signature: A cheeky grin, a bad idea and a very good excuse.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn up uninvited and cause chaos just for fun

characters.name: Davina Claire
characters.title: The Powerful Young Witch
characters.summary: Young, stubborn and far more powerful than people think. You won't be anyone's pawn.
description: Like Davina, you've had to grow up fast. She was a teenage witch hidden away in a church attic under Marcel's protection, while the whole city fought over her power.
You're tired of adults deciding things for you. Davina refused to be used by the witches, the vampires or anyone else.
You love deeply and fight back hard. When people hurt the ones she loved, Davina didn't hesitate to use everything she had.
characters.flaw: Your temper and your power are a risky mix.
characters.signature: Bare feet, a candlelit attic and far more power than anyone expected.
characters.clashReason: they'd refuse to listen to anything you told them

questions.text: Your family is in the middle of a huge argument. Where are you?

options.text: In the middle, trying to calm everyone down
Making it worse on purpose. Someone has to liven things up
Already planning a family dinner to fix it
Right at the centre of it. It's probably about you

questions.text: Someone you trusted turns on you. You...

options.text: Never forgive them. They'll regret it for a very long time
Take it to heart. Why do you always trust the wrong people?
Cut them off. You don't keep backstabbers around
Hit back harder than they ever expected

questions.text: You finally get a free evening all to yourself. You...

options.text: Paint for hours, with a glass of good bourbon
Get dressed up and go out dancing
Throw a party. The more people the better
Go for a long run through the woods

questions.text: A friend is being pushed around by someone much more powerful. You...

options.text: Stand beside them and fight, whatever it costs
Have a calm, polite word with the bully. They'll listen
Take your friend under your wing until it blows over
Get creative. The bully won't know what hit them

questions.text: Someone offers you a fresh start in a new country, no strings attached. You...

options.text: Take it. It's all you've ever wanted
Refuse. Everything you've built is here
Only go if the people who depend on you can come too
Stay. You've waited too long to be near your family to leave now

questions.text: Your friends make plans without you and you find out online. You...

options.text: Turn up anyway, uninvited, and make it memorable
Act like you don't care. You care a lot
Make your own plans. Better ones
Say nothing. Perhaps they had their reasons

questions.text: Someone underestimates you because of your age or how you look. You...

options.text: Show them exactly what you're capable of
Let them. It's fun watching them realise
Don't waste words. Just prove them wrong
Smile. You started with nothing, and look at you now

questions.text: Your resolution this year is to master a new skill. You go for...

options.text: Herbs, crystals and old books. Anything a little mystical
Something risky that everyone tells you not to try
Another language. You already speak more than you let on
Drawing. You'd fill a whole sketchbook in a week

questions.text: You're at a dinner party with friends and family. What's your role?

options.text: The host: music, drinks, everyone welcome
Cooking, and quietly making sure nobody starts a fight
You've decided exactly who sits where, and why
The guest who says something shocking over dessert

questions.text: Someone in your family does something truly awful. You...

options.text: Stand by them and help clean up the mess. Family comes first
Tell them how disappointed you are, then forgive them eventually
Look for a way to help them change, however long it takes
Look after whoever got hurt first. Family can wait

questions.text: You live in a city where vampires, witches and werewolves share an uneasy peace. One side is secretly planning to wipe out another. You...

options.text: Take control. If someone's going to run this city, it'll be you
Get every side around a table and make a deal
Protect the ones being targeted, whatever it takes
End it yourself. You're more powerful than they think

questions.text: You're immortal, and your family swore to stay together forever. A thousand years later, one of them has gone too far. You...

options.text: Keep the promise. You'll save them from themselves
Walk away and finally live your own life
Search for a spell, a cure, anything that could fix it
Make them pay a little first. They've earned it
